purpose: Lend a Mac's spare power to a weak screen: the TV gets its own isolated macOS desktop, streamed to it and driven by its remote. Not mirroring.

hardRules.rule: Never send Screen Sharing's SetDisplayConfiguration (0x1d) or write code that could.
hardRules.why: corrupts the owner's WindowServer until a reboot
hardRules.check: log show --last 10m --predicate 'eventMessage CONTAINS "created virtual display"' must be empty

hardRules.why: leaves Screen Sharing broken until a reboot

hardRules.rule: Ask the person before: creating a user, enabling Screen Sharing, any sudo, installing/uninstalling on the TV, rebooting anything, changing TV settings, signing in to accounts.
Before touching the TV, run adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep mResumedActivity; if a video app is in front, ask.
Never write passwords, tokens, IP or MAC addresses, serial numbers or account names into files, commits, issues or reports.
hardRules.why: the repository and reports are public

hardRules.rule: Prefer what mactv uninstall and the TV's own settings can undo; on the TV disable, don't uninstall.
A step is done when its check passes, not when its command returned.
